[EN] I have an idea for treating his madness, but bear with me. It's a little...unseemly.

He keeps going on and on about how "they're" watching him. He's talking about {@LinkCreature:9#410#gula pillagers}, cunning {@LinkCreature:9#700#Alizarin imp hunters} and {@LinkCreature:9#710#warders}.

Bring me their eyes. We're going to shock some sensibility into that poor man.
[ES] Tengo una idea para tratar su locura, pero ten paciencia conmigo. Es un poco... indecorosa.

No para de repetir que "ellos" lo están observando. Habla de los {@LinkCreature:9#410#gula pillagers}, los astutos {@LinkCreature:9#700#Alizarin imp hunters} y los {@LinkCreature:9#710#warders}.

Tráeme sus ojos. Vamos a devolverle la sensatez a ese pobre hombre a base de impresiones.

[EN] You'll find {@LinkCreature:9#410#Gula Pillagers}, cunning {@LinkCreature:9#700#Alizarin imp hunters} and {@LinkCreature:9#710#Alizarin Imp Warders} in the first underground floor of Azarel's Labyrinth.
[ES] Encontrarás {@LinkCreature:9#410#Gula Pillagers}, astutos {@LinkCreature:9#700#Alizarin imp hunters} y {@LinkCreature:9#710#Alizarin Imp Warders} en el primer piso subterráneo de Azarel's Labyrinth.
